subject: 明代北方府城·赌场（原创扩展）
footprint_basis: 【建议值】沿宋临安casino同功能10×8；design/22 §3.4未细分此项。
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Add realistic historical materials and architectural detail onto this EXACT locked geometric blockout. ONE Ming north China gambling hall with grey brick hard-gabled roof walls, rounded grey clay roof tiles, brown timber columns, two open front bays with exactly two plain wooden gaming tables and small ivory counters. Make materials as intricate as a realistic painted strategy-game sprite. Keep ALL geometry exactly as input: the outer thin foundation polygon, camera angles, front and side wall dimensions, 10wide by8deep ground rectangle, roof ridge and eaves axes; all diagonals rise1 per run2. No change of proportions or camera. Front footprint edge1.25 times side footprint edge. This is a MATERIALIZATION pass over the existing correct model, not a loose shape inspiration. Keep ground corners at L208,670 F830,981 R1328,732 B706,421 on1536x1152canvas. Natural upper-left illumination, subtle contact shadows only inside stone paving. True transparent RGBA everywhere outside silhouette. Full uncut sprite no people text watermark glow background modern items. No big plinth.

references.role: 精确2:1体块几何参考；仅作image_gen输入；已view_image

visual_review: 第3轮两候选选2；逐张view_image及放大底角检查。仅alpha裁去石铺外围，无变形补绘，柱脚/墙基完整；规范化成品底轴及占地比例通过。 修边只校正铺地外轮廓，内部砖缝/横梁未重投影；不等于完整3D投影验收。
source_point_semantics: 修边后可见石铺外缘L/F/R，坐标采用生成原图；raw_source_points保存裁前实测
selection_reason: 第二候选使用锁定体块生成，无首候选背景光晕；仅铺地外围可安全修边，manor裁边会损伤墙基故保留原底并登记超差。
negative: 排除项完整内嵌于prompt；工具无独立negative参数。
